requirement: My Sites delete: a teardown that left the host stack, repository, sessions or seats behind, or an answer nobody could read, is told in a notice instead of closing like a clean delete

oracle.ref: PR #828 (fix); fix evidence: Issue #801 (source-confirmed, runtime deferred). Before the fix, on the unchanged client, 11 of the delete-result browser cases failed waiting for the notice (the dialog closed as on a clean delete); after the fix they pass. Client behaviour only, against injected answers: no real host teardown, GitHub delete or dsh workspace loss was exercised.
oracle.invariant: S4: fail 0 in both files. host:false or repo:'failed' with removed:true: [data-tracy-delete-result="partial"] is shown, lists only the unconfirmed parts with the door's reason as text (or that none was reported), shows the site key, and offers exactly one action button, the acknowledgment 'Got it'; the dialog's Close control ([data-slot="dialog-close"]) is a second way to acknowledge and is not an action; exactly one DELETE was sent. repo false / 'kept' / true with every other part true: no [data-tracy-delete-result]; the delete dialog closes. Unreadable success body, removed not true, dropped connection, HTTP 5xx: [data-tracy-delete-result="unknown"]; the page never shows the 'Nothing was changed' sentence; no second DELETE. HTTP 403 / 429 / 404: no notice; the delete dialog stays open with the refusal sentence in its [role=alert]; the row is still listed. Deleting the page's own site with a partial or unknown result: 0 navigations until the notice is acknowledged, then exactly 1 (to /); with every part confirmed: 1 navigation and no notice. Tab unmounted before the answer, and last listed site deleted: the notice is still in the document. At 360px, light and dark: the notice and its Close are inside the viewport with a 16px gutter, nothing scrolls sideways, the acknowledge button can be scrolled to and pressed.
